title: Stored-material impoundments fail when material state, hydraulic state, construction history, and consequence exposure are not legible enough
summary: Candidate pattern for dams and tailings facilities: catastrophic risk is often hidden in material state, pore-water/hydraulic state, foundation or stratigraphy, construction/operation history, and downstream consequence exposure. Correction requires case memory, site knowledge, monitoring, governance, disclosure, and consequence classification, but these rails do not guarantee safety.

status_history.note: Created after promoting Teton, Mount Polley, Brumadinho, Fundão, ASDSO/DamFailures.org, GISTM, and Global Tailings Portal records.

place.scope: cross-case water dam and tailings impoundment pattern candidate

claims.claim: Teton, Mount Polley, Brumadinho, and Fundão all make the cube ask what surface was supposed to reveal the actual material, foundation, hydraulic, or construction-history state before breach, but the mechanisms differ and must not be collapsed.
what_would_change_status: Negative-control cases, near-miss/intercepted cases, or second-pass source extraction show the apparent commonality is too broad or misleading.

claims.claim: The correction rail is multi-layered rather than singular: ASDSO/DamFailures.org provides case memory, GISTM provides lifecycle governance/auditable requirements, and the Global Tailings Portal provides disclosure-denominator visibility, but none of these prove implementation or safety.
what_would_change_status: Conformance audits or incident data show these rails are ineffective, incomplete, or differently scoped than the candidate assumes.

claims.claim: The pattern remains candidate-only because the cube has not yet promoted positive controls, negative controls, recommendation/conformance-closure records, or a denominator audit of impoundments that did not fail under similar surface conditions.
what_would_change_status: Sufficient controls and closure audits support narrowing or maturation; otherwise it remains a search frame.

evidence_profile.known_bias: cases selected for known failures; needs near-misses, successful interventions, and denominator controls

positive_controls_needed: Impoundment/dam where high-risk material/hydraulic state was detected and corrected before failure.
Tailings facility with documented GISTM/independent-review intervention that changed design, water management, or emergency planning before harm.
negative_controls_needed: Dam/tailings failure where visible material/hydraulic/construction-state issues are not explanatory and a different dominant mechanism controls.
Stable impoundment with similar upstream/construction/material features but robust controls and no failure.
counterexamples_to_seek: Cases where monitoring provided actionable warning but governance/emergency response failed rather than material-state legibility.
Cases dominated by external flood/earthquake exceedance rather than hidden internal material state.
rollback_triggers: Second-pass reports show the shared axes are so broad they become tautological.
Controls reveal the pattern mostly restates post hoc failure analysis rather than predictive/corrective structure.
The record encourages unsafe simplification across water dams, tailings dams, levees, and waste impoundments.

required_before_maturity: full-report extraction for each promoted case
clear separation of water-dam, tailings, levee, and waste-impoundment mechanisms

handling_notes: Pattern records must not flatten disasters into slogan-level lessons or imply all dam/tailings failures have the same mechanism.
Do not mature this pattern without positive controls, negative controls, near-miss/intercepted cases, and recommendation/conformance closure audits.

unknowns: The pattern is selected from failures and therefore has strong survivorship/failure-selection bias.
No near-miss or caught-before-harm control record exists yet.
Recommendation and conformance closure after these failures is not yet extracted.
next_actions: Promote at least one positive-control/intercepted impoundment record and one negative-control record.
Extract full Teton and Fundão reports and archive/source-hash PDFs.
Create conformance/recommendation closure child records for GISTM, Mount Polley, and Brumadinho.
